title: NativeExportReceipt
description: The reproducible/auditable proof that one native export happened: which output_mode, against which exact source (source_hash), what bytes it produced (export_hash), and the sidecar/diff/context-response it bound together. source_hash AND export_hash are BOTH required so the export can be reproduced and audited: the same source under the same mode must yield the same export_hash. context_response_id is optional (present only for baltor_native/dual/compare modes). receipt_id links back to the runtime's existing receipt ledger — this contract adds NO 2nd ledger.
